description: The tourist stands in the empty cobbled piazza facing the Fountain of the Four Rivers, its sculpted rocks and towering obelisk rising center-frame. Behind it stands Sant'Agnese with its dome and twin bell towers, flanked by ochre and cream palazzi that stretch to both edges. The 07:11 morning sun gilds the upper facades while the fountain's basin still lies in soft shadow.
